provenance.source: NECB 2020 and NECB 2025 Division B Table 4.2.1.6, columns "Automatic Daylight Responsive Controls for Sidelighting [see 4.2.2.1.(10)]" and "... for Toplighting [see 4.2.2.1.(13)]", retrieved via the building-codes MCP (get_table necb 4.2.1.6, editions 2020 and 2025) and RE-READ 2026-07-30 after canmet-energy/hbix#88 corrected the extraction.
provenance.method: Re-generated 2026-07-30 from the CORRECTED extraction. The nine lighting-control columns are now verified against the printed pages and the two editions agree exactly - asserted at generation time, 0 differing cells of 909 - so the earlier '2025 is primary, 2020 may corroborate but never negate' conflict machinery is obsolete and has been removed. Cell semantics: 'X' -> required; '-' -> not_required; BLANK occurs only on the four rows carrying a Note that defers the space type elsewhere (Guest room -> 4.2.2.6.(2); Parking garage - interior -> 4.2.2.2.; Stairway -> the space containing it; Healthcare medical supply room -> the Storage Room rows), and those keep their curated state. Entries with no table_row are not in Table 4.2.1.6 at all. Note (1) also defines 'A'/'B' as at-least-one-of-group marks, but BOTH daylight columns are pure X/-/blank, so consuming only 'X' is sound for these two columns (checked; the A/B marks sit in the manual and occupancy columns).

semantics.required: Table 4.2.1.6 carries 'X' in the column - 4.2.2.1.(10) or (13) applies to this space type, subject to its own power thresholds and to the (12)/(15) exceptions
semantics.not_required: the column is blank or a dash in BOTH extractions - the sentence does not apply to this space type
semantics.not_applicable: Table 4.2.1.6 refers this space type to a DIFFERENT article instead of carrying a flag (4.2.2.2. for interior storage garages, 4.2.2.6.(2) for guest rooms)
semantics.unknown: the two extractions CONFLICT, the cell holds header/footnote text, or the space type has no row at all. Callers must not silently decide - the gem WARNS and applies the documented conservative default
semantics.not_listed: the space type has NO Table 4.2.1.6 row at all, and 4.2.2.1.(10)/(13) apply only to spaces requiring the control 'in accordance with Table 4.2.1.6.' - so the sentences do not reach it. A determination from the code text, distinct from 'unknown'

provenance.residue_note: Four extraction CONFLICTs were RESOLVED on 2026-07-30 when canmet-energy/hbix#88 was fixed; each now reads its mark directly and no longer relies on the conservative 'required' default. The 5 remaining entries are structural - those space types have no Table 4.2.1.6 row at all - and are unaffected by extraction quality.

- undefined -.note: catalog sentinel for an unlisted space function (4.2.1.6.(1)(b) is a human judgement); the gem's reference transform already hard-raises on it
